notes: Cash basis county, governmental funds only (no business-type funds). Statement lines from the Total Governmental column (p4). Balance sheet from the governmental funds Balance Sheet - Cash Basis (p3; totals equal the Statement of Net Position, p1). General Fund budget Taxes 3,997,347 split using the General column of p4 (Property Taxes + Motor Vehicle Tax). Detail: budget schedules for General, Road, Self Insurance and Inheritance Tax funds (pp5-9); nonmajor funds from the Schedule 2 combining columns (Special Revenue Funds combined, Jail Bond, Nursing Home Bond; p10); the Schedule 4 special revenue combining pages (15 funds, pp11-13) and the Schedule 5 nonmajor budget totals (pp14-17) are not recorded separately to avoid double counting. Statement of Activities classifies 2 more of intergovernmental/grants and 2 less of inheritance tax than Exhibit D (same total). Read pages 1-17 of 17
